C1.rationale: Level 3: Disseminating scientific findings across diverse pharmaceutical stakeholders, participating in professional interview practice, and team inquiry.
evidenceLines: Communicate the project outcomes in written and oral form to a diverse audience of Pharmaceutical Science stakeholders
You will participate in activities to develop your job seeking, career planning and professional communication skills, such as writing resumes, and practising interview techniques.

C2.rationale: Level 3: Formulating technical solutions to unstandardized industry problems and discovering novel drug delivery candidates.
evidenceLines: Propose and justify an approach to solving an industry-relevant problem
You will develop the knowledge and practical skills critical to the discovery and development of new drugs and therapies leading to exciting careers in research and industry.

C3.rationale: Level 3: Critical appraisal of computational models in drug development and rigorous evaluation of biological receptor interactions.
evidenceLines: Critically analyse the use of computational methods in drug development
Propose and justify an approach to solving an industry-relevant problem

C4.rationale: Level 3: Designing molecular formulations, computational ligand docking simulations, and developing chemical therapies.
evidenceLines: In this course, you will learn about the chemistry, biology and technology of medicines and other chemical formulations and how to improve human health and well-being by researching and developing more reliable, accessible and effective treatments and products.
It will cover important molecular modelling methods including molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and quantum mechanical calculations, as well as bioinformatics methods.

C5.rationale: Level 3: Independent investigative research project or industry placement synthesizing cutting-edge formulation science.
evidenceLines: In the final year, you will gain practical skills through a major research project or industry placement and be ready for a career in pharmaceutical research, the biomedical industry and many other fields both nationally and internationally that require advanced chemical-formulation skills.
Propose and justify an approach to solving an industry-relevant problem

W1.rationale: Level 3: Compulsory industry placement immersion and training in industry-standard laboratory environments.
evidenceLines: In the second half of the unit, you will complete a compulsory industry placement, which will give you the opportunity to expand your understanding of the industry and to hone your professional skills.

You will study with one of the largest and most productive groups of pharmaceutical researchers in Australia, the Monash Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, and will graduate having worked in industry-standard facilities, such as our Shimadzu high-pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC) lab.

W2.rationale: Level 3: Professional workplace compliance, chemical safety protocols, and ethical governance of therapeutic products.
evidenceLines: Work safely and effectively in a professional environment

In this course, you will learn about the chemistry, biology and technology of medicines and other chemical formulations and how to improve human health and well-being by researching and developing more reliable, accessible and effective treatments and products.

W3.rationale: Level 3: Mastery of advanced analytical instrumentation (HPLC), Python-based chemoinformatics, and molecular modeling platforms.
evidenceLines: The unit will teach fundamental programming skills using the widely-used programming language Python and apply them to the key skills of as data visualization, chemoinformatics, and machine learning.

You will study with one of the largest and most productive groups of pharmaceutical researchers in Australia, the Monash Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, and will graduate having worked in industry-standard facilities, such as our Shimadzu high-pressure liquid chromatography (HPLC) lab.

evidenceLines: The unit will teach fundamental programming skills using the widely-used programming language Python and apply them to the key skills of as data visualization, chemoinformatics, and machine learning.
